scope_summary.value: Partial HVAC replacement at Rena B. Wright Primary School in Chesapeake, Virginia. Demolition of all existing rooftop multi-zone units (classrooms + media center), rooftop units (cafeteria, office, kitchen, gym, single zone), kitchen hood + exhaust + makeup air system, roof-mounted exhaust fans, electric unit heaters, impacted ceilings + light fixtures, and the complete existing HVAC control system. New work: RTUs with curbs, ductwork, grills, and fan-powered series VAV boxes in classrooms and media center; single packaged gas rooftop units in gym/cafeteria/office/kitchen/single-zone areas; new code-compliant kitchen hood system with fire suppression; new roof-mounted exhaust fans; new electric unit heaters; 2×2 lay-in ceilings with new LED lights; new Trane DDC wireless control system; ductless mini-splits for MDF and IDF closets; new gas piping with supports.

equipment_procurement.value: Chesapeake Public Schools pre-purchased HVAC equipment, curbs, and isolation rails directly from Damuth Trane; the Controls package and Equipment Start-up included in the General Contract.

disciplines_scope.value: Mechanical (HVAC + ductwork + controls + kitchen hood + suppression); Electrical (RTU and exhaust-fan power, fire alarm, LED lighting); Structural (rooftop support work); Plumbing-adjacent (gas piping); ceilings
